description:
The Firmstrong Bruiser Fat Tire takes our classic cruiser look and packs it with oversized 26-inch x 4-inch tires to give you more freedom than ever before. While a standard cruiser is perfect for the boardwalk, the Bruiser Fat Tire is built for the rider who wants to keep going where the pavement ends. Those massive 4-inch tires aren’t just for show—they allow the bike to stay on top of soft sand, loose dirt, and uneven trails where thinner tires would simply sink or get stuck. Optimized for men from 5 feet 6 inches to 6 feet 5 inches tall, the reinforced Thick-Top-Tube frame provides a rock-solid, spacious ride for anyone who needs a bike that can handle more weight and tougher terrain.

At the heart of the Bruiser Fat Tire is the Shimano 7-speed gear system. We chose this setup specifically to give you the extra help needed to move those larger wheels with ease. Whether you’re pedaling against a stiff ocean breeze or climbing a coastal hill, the seven speeds ensure you never feel like you're struggling. You get the rugged capability of an off-road bike, but you still get to enjoy the signature Firmstrong upright position that keeps your back straight and takes the strain off your shoulders.

To handle the extra weight and momentum of the fat tire build, we’ve equipped this model with Tektro Mechanical Disc Brakes. Traditional handbrakes can sometimes struggle in wet or sandy conditions, but disc brakes provide much stronger, more reliable stopping power exactly when you need it. This is a critical safety feature for a high-capacity bike designed to support up to 400 pounds. The Bruiser Fat Tire 7-Speed is a durable, high-performance upgrade for the rider who wants a classic cruiser look with the actual strength to tackle any environment.

19-Inch Reinforced Steel Frame with a high-tensile Thick-Tube design for maximum strength and durability

26-Inch x 4.0-Inch Fat Tires provide incredible traction and a stable ride on sand, gravel, and dirt where standard tires sink

7-Speed Shimano Gearing offers a wide range of speeds to make pedaling the larger wheels easy on hills or long-distance rides

Front and Rear Tektro Disc Brakes deliver powerful, consistent stopping control even in wet or sandy conditions

Dual Spring Oversized Seat for added comfort on bumpy trails and longer cruises

Heavy-Duty Alloy Rims with 14G Stainless Steel spokes to handle tough terrain and

28.5-Inch Wide Cruiser Handlebars with synthetic leather grips for a relaxed, upright riding position

Bicycle Weighs approximately 55 lbs. Fully Assembled

Fits Most Men 5’6” – 6’5” Tall and is built to support riders up to 400 lbs

Recommended Riding Speed 3 – 25 mph

Recommended Riding Distance 0 – 35 miles in a single trip

The Seat and Handlebar Height and Tilt can be adjusted to properly fit the rider

Bike comes 85% Assembled, Assembly is easy and fun!

Designed in Hermosa Beach, CA.
